caption: The drawing depicts a single spoon in realistic grayscale pencil, shown in a vertical orientation with the handle at the bottom and the bowl at the top. To the left of the spoon, there are two boxes, each containing detailed sketches that highlight specific sections of the spoon. The upper box contains a close-up view of the handle, showing engraved letters and symbols, including "AST" and "DM" with additional ornamentation such as a small design between the letters. The lower box displays the outline of the spoon’s bowl and a detail of its junction with the handle, emphasizing the shape and connection. The main drawing of the spoon reveals subtle shading to indicate the metallic texture, and intricate designs are visible on the handle. The background is a plain off-white color, and the drawing includes the handwritten words “actual size” at the bottom left and the name “Geo Halpin” at the bottom right.
title: Pewter Spoon
